name: Ghost of Tokyo
source:
I woke up in a dirty alley somewhere in Shinjuku. No name. No memories. No past. Just a pounding headache and the distant glow of Tokyo’s neon lights burning through the rain.

I don’t know who I am. But I know what I can do.

They can’t see me. I walk right past them — through crowded streets, into locked rooms, behind closed doors. I’m the shadow they never notice. The breath on their neck, they can’t explain. The Ghost of Tokyo.

Every street, every room, every encounter becomes a choice. Do I observe… or intervene? Do I remain invisible… or leave a trace? Do I resist temptation… or give in to it?

From quiet college campuses to luxury apartments, from hidden love hotels to late-night izakayas — every location hides new paths, new encounters, and new consequences. The women I meet each have their own lives, routines, and secrets… and how I choose to interact with them shapes what unfolds next.

Some moments are fleeting. Others change everything.

The more I explore, the more I realize: this isn’t just about finding my past.

It’s about deciding who I want to become.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4620930/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我在新宿某处肮脏的小巷中醒来。没有名字。没有记忆。没有过去。只有剧烈的头痛和远处东京霓虹灯在雨中燃烧的光芒。

我不知道我是谁。但我知道我能做什么。

他们看不到我。我径直从他们身边走过——穿过拥挤的街道，走进上锁的房间，关上门。我是他们从未注意到的影子。他们脖子上的气息，他们无法解释。东京之魂.

每一条街道、每一个房间、每一次相遇都成为一种选择。我是观察……还是干预？我会保持隐形……还是留下痕迹？我是抵制诱惑……还是屈服于诱惑？

从安静的大学校园到豪华公寓，从隐秘的情人旅馆到深夜的居酒屋——每个地点都隐藏着新的道路、新的遭遇和新的后果。我遇到的女性都有自己的生活、惯例和秘密……而我选择与她们互动的方式决定了接下来发生的事情。

有些瞬间转瞬即逝。其他人改变了一切。

我探索得越多，我就越意识到：这不仅仅是寻找我的过去。

这是关于决定我想成为谁。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4620930/]Steam[/url]]
